note: Mega ability implementation manifest (D-5). Generated by tools/generate-megas.mjs from tools/lib/megaRules.mjs. 'implemented' becomes true only when utils/battle/abilities.js models the rule and its tests pass.

engineRequirements.stat stages: Per-battler stages −6…+6 for atk/def/spa/spd/spe with multipliers (2+n)/2 and 2/(2−n), applied in computeStats-derived values at damage and turn-order time; reset when the battler faints.
engineRequirements.switch-in effects: A hook when a battler enters (battle start and after a faint), ordered by Speed, logged for playback.
engineRequirements.end-of-turn effects: A phase after both moves resolve each turn (weather damage, Speed Boost, Solar Power), with KO handling and logging.
engineRequirements.weather: A battle-wide field (sun, rain, sand, snow, strong winds) with a duration (5 turns for abilities as of Gen 6+; strong winds until the setter leaves), damage modifiers, sand chip damage and immunities.
engineRequirements.terrain: A battle-wide terrain field (Electric Terrain: grounded Electric moves ×1.3, 5 turns).
engineRequirements.status: burn: A non-volatile status on the battler: burn halves physical damage dealt and deals 1/16 max HP at end of turn; Fire-types are immune.
engineRequirements.mutable battler types: Battler types become per-battle state (already a field on the battler; must stay out of the species data).

abilities.name: Adaptability
abilities.rule: STAB multiplier 2 instead of 1.5.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's same-type attack bonus (STAB) is 2 instead of 1.5.

abilities.name: Aerilate
abilities.rule: Normal-type moves become Flying-type and get ×1.2 power.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Flying type and have 1.2× power.

abilities.name: Aura Break
abilities.rule: Reverses Fairy Aura/Dark Aura (only matters against Mega Floette, which is blocked).
abilities.showdownDescription: While this Pokemon is active, the Dark Aura and Fairy Aura power modifier is 0.75×.

abilities.name: Aura Guard
abilities.rule: Contact damage taken ×0.5 (Showdown, Future).
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from contact moves.

abilities.name: Bad Dreams
abilities.rule: Damages sleeping foes; status is not simulated.
abilities.showdownDescription: Causes sleeping foes to lose 1/8 of their max HP at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.rule: +1 Sp. Atk when an attack drops it below half HP.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is raised by 1 when it reaches 1/2 or less of its max HP.

abilities.name: Bulletproof
abilities.rule: Immune to ball and bomb moves.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon is immune to bullet moves.

abilities.name: Commander
abilities.rule: Doubles-only interaction with Dondozo.
abilities.showdownDescription: If ally is Dondozo: this Pokemon cannot act or be hit, +2 to all Dondozo's stats.

abilities.name: Contrary
abilities.rule: Stat changes are inverted (only matters once moves or abilities change stats).
abilities.showdownDescription: If this Pokemon has a stat stage raised it is lowered instead, and vice versa.

abilities.name: Defiant
abilities.rule: +2 Attack when an opponent lowers its stats (e.g. Intimidate).
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 2 for each of its stats that is lowered by a foe.

abilities.name: Delta Stream
abilities.rule: Sets strong winds (removes Flying weaknesses).
abilities.showdownDescription: On switch-in, strong winds begin until this Ability is not active in battle.

abilities.name: Dragonize
abilities.rule: Normal-type moves become Dragon-type and get ×1.2 power (Showdown, Future).
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Dragon type and have 1.2× power.

abilities.name: Drought
abilities.rule: Sets harsh sunlight on entry.
abilities.showdownDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sun.

abilities.name: Eelevate
abilities.rule: Ground immunity, plus +1 to its highest stat after a KO (Showdown, Future).
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Ground; +1 to highest stat if it KOes another Pokemon.

abilities.name: Electric Surge
abilities.rule: Sets Electric Terrain on entry.
abilities.showdownDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Electric Terrain.

abilities.name: Fairy Aura
abilities.rule: Fairy-type moves of both battlers ×4/3.
abilities.showdownDescription: While this Pokemon is active, a Fairy move used by any Pokemon has 1.33× power.

abilities.name: Filter
abilities.rule: Super-effective damage taken ×0.75.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.

abilities.name: Fire Mane
abilities.rule: Attacking stat ×1.5 for Fire-type moves (Showdown, Future).
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.

abilities.name: Flame Body
abilities.rule: 30% chance to burn an attacker on contact.
abilities.showdownDescription: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be burned.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.rule: Fire immunity; after absorbing one, own Fire moves ×1.5 (per-battler flag, no stat stages).
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Fire attacks do 1.5× damage if hit by one Fire move; Fire immunity.

abilities.name: Healer
abilities.rule: Cures an ally's status in doubles; no doubles or status.
abilities.showdownDescription: 30% chance this Pokemon's ally has its status cured at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Huge Power
abilities.rule: Attack ×2.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is doubled.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.rule: Ignores screens and substitutes; none are simulated.
abilities.showdownDescription: Moves ignore substitutes and foe's Reflect/Light Screen/Safeguard/Mist/Aurora Veil.

abilities.name: Innards Out
abilities.rule: When KO'd by a move, the attacker loses HP equal to the damage taken.
abilities.showdownDescription: If this Pokemon is KOed with a move, that move's user loses an equal amount of HP.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.rule: Blocks Intimidate (Gen 8+), implemented with Intimidate in Phase M2. Flinching isn't simulated.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. Immune to Intimidate.

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.rule: Prevents sleep; status is not simulated.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.rule: On entry, lowers the opponent's Attack by 1.
abilities.showdownDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opponents by 1 stage.

abilities.name: Iron Fist
abilities.rule: Punching moves ×1.2.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have 1.2× power. Sucker Punch is not boosted.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.rule: Immune to Ground-type moves.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon is immune to Ground; Gravity/Ingrain/Smack Down/Iron Ball nullify it.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
abilities.rule: Electric immunity, plus +1 Sp. Atk when hit by one.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon draws Electric moves to itself to raise Sp. Atk by 1; Electric immunity.

abilities.name: Magic Bounce
abilities.rule: Reflects status moves; movesets contain only damaging moves.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon blocks certain Status moves and bounces them back to the user.

abilities.name: Mega Launcher
abilities.rule: Pulse moves ×1.5.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's pulse moves have 1.5× power. Heal Pulse heals 3/4 target's max HP.

abilities.name: Mega Sol
abilities.rule: Own moves act as in harsh sunlight: Fire ×1.5, Water ×0.5 (Showdown, Future).
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's moves are used as if the effects of Sun were active.

abilities.name: Mold Breaker
abilities.rule: Ignores the target's ability (only relevant against another battler with an ability).
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

abilities.name: Multiscale
abilities.rule: Damage taken ×0.5 while at full HP.
abilities.showdownDescription: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.rule: Every move used by or against this battler hits.
abilities.showdownDescription: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.

abilities.name: Parental Bond
abilities.rule: Single-hit damaging moves hit a second time at ×0.25.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's damaging moves hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered.

abilities.name: Piercing Drill
abilities.rule: Hits through protection; no protecting moves are simulated.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.

abilities.name: Pixilate
abilities.rule: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type and get ×1.2 power.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy type and have 1.2× power.

abilities.name: Prankster
abilities.rule: Priority for status moves; movesets contain only damaging moves.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Status moves have priority raised by 1, but Dark types are immune.

abilities.name: Protean
abilities.rule: Before attacking, its type becomes the move's type (always STAB; defensive type changes).
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of the move it is using. Once per switch-in.

abilities.name: Pure Power
abilities.rule: Attack ×2.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is doubled.

abilities.name: Refrigerate
abilities.rule: Normal-type moves become Ice-type and get ×1.2 power.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice type and have 1.2× power.

abilities.name: Regenerator
abilities.rule: Heals on switching out; there is no voluntary switching.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when it switches out.

abilities.name: Sand Force
abilities.rule: Rock/Ground/Steel moves ×1.3 in a sandstorm; immune to sand damage.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Ground/Rock/Steel attacks do 1.3× in Sandstorm; immunity to it.

abilities.name: Sand Stream
abilities.rule: Sets a sandstorm on entry.
abilities.showdownDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.

abilities.name: Scrappy
abilities.rule: Normal- and Fighting-type moves hit Ghost-types.
abilities.showdownDescription: Fighting, Normal moves hit Ghost. Immune to Intimidate.

abilities.name: Shadow Tag
abilities.rule: Prevents switching; there is no voluntary switching.
abilities.showdownDescription: Prevents foes from choosing to switch unless they also have this Ability.

abilities.name: Sharpness
abilities.rule: Slicing moves ×1.5.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's slicing moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Sheer Force
abilities.rule: Moves with secondary effects ×1.3 (secondary effects are not simulated anyway).
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's attacks with secondary effects have 1.3× power; nullifies the effects.

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.rule: Can't be hit by critical hits.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

abilities.name: Skill Link
abilities.rule: Multi-hit moves always hit the maximum number of times.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's multi-hit attacks always hit the maximum number of times.

abilities.name: Snow Warning
abilities.rule: Sets snow on entry.
abilities.showdownDescription: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Snow.

abilities.name: Solar Power
abilities.rule: Sp. Atk ×1.5 in sun, loses 1/8 HP each turn.
abilities.showdownDescription: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5×; loses 1/8 max HP per turn.

abilities.name: Soul-Heart
abilities.rule: +1 Sp. Atk whenever any battler faints.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 1 stage when another Pokemon faints.

abilities.name: Speed Boost
abilities.rule: +1 Speed at the end of each turn.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Speed is raised 1 stage at the end of each full turn on the field.

abilities.name: Spicy Spray
abilities.rule: Burns any attacker that hits it (Showdown, Future).
abilities.showdownDescription: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the attacker becomes burned.

abilities.name: Stalwart
abilities.rule: Ignores redirection; singles battles have none.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's moves cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.

abilities.name: Steadfast
abilities.rule: Speed up on flinch; flinching is not simulated.
abilities.showdownDescription: If this Pokemon flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.

abilities.name: Storm Drain
abilities.rule: Water immunity, plus +1 Sp. Atk when hit by one.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon draws Water moves to itself to raise Sp. Atk by 1; Water immunity.

abilities.name: Strong Jaw
abilities.rule: Biting moves ×1.5.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's bite-based attacks have 1.5× power. Bug Bite is not boosted.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.rule: Speed ×2 in rain.
abilities.showdownDescription: If Rain is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

abilities.name: Technician
abilities.rule: Moves with power ≤ 60 get ×1.5.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have 1.5× power, including Struggle.

abilities.name: Thermal Exchange
abilities.rule: +1 Attack when hit by a Fire move; can't be burned.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 when damaged by Fire moves; can't be burned.

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.rule: Fire- and Ice-type damage taken ×0.5.
abilities.showdownDescription: Fire-/Ice-type moves against this Pokemon deal damage with a halved offensive stat.

abilities.name: Tough Claws
abilities.rule: Contact moves ×1.3.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's contact moves have their power multiplied by 1.3.

abilities.name: Trace
abilities.rule: Copies the opposing battler's ability on entry (Phase M2); ordinary battlers have none, so it only matters against another Mega.
abilities.showdownDescription: On switch-in, or when it can, this Pokemon copies a random adjacent foe's Ability.

abilities.name: Unseen Fist
abilities.rule: Ignores protection; no protecting moves are simulated.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore the target's protection, except Max Guard.

abilities.name: Volt Absorb
abilities.rule: Electric immunity; heals 1/4 max HP when hit by an Electric move.
abilities.showdownDescription: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Electric moves; Electric immunity.
